notes.title: Red Lantern and Gold Coins - DreadHaunt Update 20240212
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/5a0bf7efea472448e26d4283efffecd923b86b91.png

Greetings, Agents!

First of all, happy Lunar New Year! And now, the HQ is presenting news regarding DreadHaunt’s latest update, just in time for this festivities!


Seasonal Environment – CNY

Embrace the spirit of the Lunar New Year with the new seasonal ornament! We hope that this seasonal environment will freshen up your haunting sessions. We even managed to snap some footage directly from the field.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/56797effdfd5768a62fb2436a7002d8da5bc4d30.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/b6f56fbad7faa8340811599c67dda00b88916299.jpg


Bug Fixes and Improvements

As usual, We squashed some bugs and fine-tuned several aspects to ensure smooth gameplay. However, don’t hesitate to reach out if you have feedback and suggestions!


Future Update Sneak Peek

Based on the timeline that we shared, the single-player mode is in the works. We’re also working on the game economy like XP accumulation and cosmetics rewards.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1855580/extras/content_release_plan_fixed.jpg?t=1703069105

That is all for now. Thank you for your continued support for DreadHaunt!

notes.title: DreadHaunt Update 2023-12-20
notes.notes:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33371531/07d380d2395eacdd707e403d3e5806bfd69af98a.png
Good day, Agents.

We have updated DreadHaunt to version 20231218, and these are notable details that the HQ want to share:

Post-Session Results Screen

After each session, you’ll be presented with an eye-catching post-result screen. Showing who’s the possessed one, who survived (or didn’t), and how many points you racked up during the mission. 

(Ongoing) Audio Updates

We decided to overhaul the Audio System including BGM & SFX assets. You will notice a few changes during gameplay

(Ongoing) Controller Support

Controller support is available in very early stage. If you the controller-wielding type of agent, we are looking forward to hear your experiences!

Bug Fixes, Here and There

- Added subtitle size option to Settings.
- Spectro damage effect +15%
- Kunti attack charge 25 -> 28.75
- Asih attack charge 10 -> 11.5
- Prevent drop tools while opening voter
- BugFix: Kunti attack charge hit multiple times
- Add condition to disable host quit button when in game
- add descriptions to sprectro skills
- fix mouse cursor not reappearing during waiting for players

Known Bugs/Glitches

- BGM not playing on Versus Mode
- etc.

Sneak Peek of Future Contents

We have a Content Update Plans on the DreadHaunt store page, check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1855580/DreadHaunt/

Last but not least, if you have any suggestions or experienced bugs or glitches about the game, Feel free to reach us out on Steam Community Forum and our official discord server at discord.gg/dreaduniverse

notes.title: Merry Christmas and Happy New Year 2021! 1.1.5 update released
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
2020 it’s a really challenging time for all of us, some of our plans and schedules are not well implemented during this unique time. And yet we are very grateful with all of your support, DreadOut 2 is slowly improving and the responses are well received (with 58% mixed reviews during our rocky launch and now 71% mostly positive). 

With 2021 approaching closer as well, we would like to wish you Merry Christmas and Happy New Year 2021! May you & your loved ones be blessed with joyful heart, happiness in your home, peace in your soul and joy in your life. Today and always.

Today we have updated DreadOut 2 to version 1.1.5 that contains some minor bug fixes and the most part are adding some new localizations as well. We are adding Hungarian and Spain localization in this update. Shoot out to our friend Brechler Zsolt who helps us with the Hungarian translation, and Alberto Aniorte R for Spanish translation. They both are supporting us since the first DreadOut, really appreciate their help! 

The detailed patch are listed in the notes below;
1.1.5 patch notes

Stay tuned for more information, we hope you enjoy DreadOut 2 as much as we do. Be well, stay safe, and Cheers!  Again, thank you for your endless support!

All the best, 
Digital Happiness

==============================================================================

Halo semua,
2020 merupakan tahun yang penuh tantangan bagi kita semua, beberapa perencanaan dan skedul kami tidak bisa terimplementasi dengan baik. Namun kami tetap bersyukur dengan dukungan kalian semua. DreadOut 2 secara perlahan membaik dengan dukungan serta respon positif yang terus kami dapatkan (58% mixed reviews saat perilisan awal sampai dengan saat ini di 71% positif reviews)

Menjelang datangnya tahun 2021 tidak lama lagi, kami juga mengucapkan Selamat Hari Natal dan Tahun baru 2021 bagi yang merayakan. Semoga kita semua diberkati dengan kebahagiaan, keriaan dan kesehatan yang baik. 

Hari ini juga kita telah merilis DreadOut 2 versi 1.1.5 yang berisi beberapa perbaikan revisi minor dan yang paling utama adalah memberikan tambahan subtitle Spanyol dan Hungaria. New Story campaign update

 New Alternate Ending
 New Irisphone app for costumes changing
 New costumes
 New Boss

Free DLC DreadOut: The Untolds comic
Several gameplay improvements and boss battle tweaks

And the detail change fixed list:
Changes and fixed list

notes.title: DreadOut 2 Version 1.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Recently, we have an update to further improving DreadOut 2 experience, eliminating further newly founded bugs as well.

This update also contains a major change in terms of Achievement trophy, where we removed BURIK achievement as we have told you in previous DreadOut 2 Version 1.0.1 Update patch notes. The BURIK (an anagram of RUBIK) was a Rubik's cube player need to solve and tied to our achievement. Alas, it just brings headache to all of us, both the solver and the game (as some of you might have experienced, it occasionally missing in the level and shown back upon reloading checkpoints).

We do not have an exact answer as to why it happened so randomly except that it possibly related to the collision and numerical stability of the game engine, hence we removed it completely (both the cube and the achievement). The version is bumped to 1.1.0 from 1.0.1 because of this decision. Hope you understand.

For more complete patch notes, see below:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/945710/discussions/0/1751275426755601120/

Along with this update, we’re still open to any other reports that can potentially reduce your experience while playing DreadOut 2. Stay tuned for more updates from us, as we’re moving into polishing, balancing and tweaking some detail parts that need to be addressed as well.

Thank you for your patience and kind support.
DH

notes.title: DreadOut 2 version 1.01 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
First of all, thank you for giving us tremendous supports and feedback within our rocky 3 days launch of DreadOut 2. With your support and patience, we will improve DreadOut 2 experience’s that it deserved.

Along with this announcement, we have just released our updates and fix to solve some potentially game-breaking progress that players reported. Also, an improvement in user experience as well, save and load, optimizing, tweaking some of the boss battles, etc. 

Your save game would be fine, so that you can continue your progress through there. This fix may not solve all of the issues that players encountered. But we can only promise that we will be continually updating our build. You can look at all the details of bug fixing through here;

https://steamcommunity.com/app/945710/discussions/0/1751275426755601120/

Please kindly updates your game with our latest build. We are really encouraging everyone to keep posting and report any issues along the way and share your experience with us.

All the best,
DH
